dt: NSTGRO27 (Fall 2027) released Nov 6, 2026 via NSPIRES: mandatory preliminary proposals due Dec 9, 2026; grants.gov lists a Mar 18, 2027 close date for full proposals
e: Graduate fellowships for space-technology research such as sensors, optics and materials. Each fellow gets a NASA collaborator and a visiting-technologist stay at a NASA center. U.S. citizens, nationals and permanent residents only; applicants must be undergraduates or first-year graduate students at the time of applying.
n: NASA Space Technology Graduate Research Opportunities (NSTGRO)
unv: The $40,000 student stipend figure comes from an earlier solicitation; the NSTGRO27 grants.gov notice (NNH26ZTR001N-26NSTGRO-B4) lists an $84,000 award maximum and 35 awards. Time of day of the deadlines and the eligibility profiles in section B.1 of the appendix were not checked.
